title: EEG features and major depressive disorder
abstract: Major depressive disorder is associated with EEG biomarkers, sadness, anhedonia, sleep disturbance, and fatigue. PHQ-9 and HAMD are commonly used. Psychotherapy and fluoxetine may improve depression symptoms.

title: Psychological stress and social isolation in depression
abstract: Depressive disorder is associated with psychological stress, family history, and social isolation as risk factors. Cognitive behavioral therapy can treat major depression.
